prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 90.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 67.3%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 89.4%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 73.5%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 30.4%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Generation Preview Stage: Insert a dedicated pet preview stage screen before adoption certificate generation to confirm pet appearance. (why: Adoption drops 32.7% of users and 3 support emails reported custom pets failing or looking wrong after setup.)
1: [home, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Companion Sandbox: Add an interactive sandbox playground screen while rendering assets in the background so users stay engaged. (why: Home step waiting time has a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading users to abandon or assume the app froze.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Home Sign-In Transition: Move sign-in after desktop waiting completes so users sign in only after seeing their active pet. (why: 8 support emails mentioned pets missing or resetting after signing in again, and saving after desktop init preserves local state.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Account Pet Sync Guarantee Notice: Add clear reassuring microcopy explaining that signing in saves current pet data without overwriting local pets. (why: 8 support emails reported pet loss or account reset confusion during sign-in.)
4: [finish, hint] Interactive Pet Tray Control Hint: Display a explicit hint on the home intro screen detailing how to access and control the pet from the system tray. (why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)
5: [home, wait_info] Render Progress & Time Remaining Estimate: Enable estimated completion time and progress status indicators on the waiting screen. (why: Waiting step takes a mean of 2336s, causing uncertainty about rendering status.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop Readiness Sound & Visual Alert: Play an audio chime and toggle readiness notifications when pet setup finishes in the background. (why: Mean waiting time is over 38 minutes, meaning users switch away to other desktop apps during onboarding.)
7: [choose_path, layout] Two-Column Path Comparison Cards: Update choose_path layout to a side-by-side two-column view contrasting quick adoption with custom creation. (why: High mean time (514s) on choose_path shows users spend time evaluating options.)
